question: Do I need a permit to put up a shed in my back yard?
notes: CITIZEN VOICE. Written deliberately in the register a resident uses at the counter, not statutory language. Added 2026-08-03 after discovering the existing suites were phrased semi-statutorily and therefore could not detect the citizen-phrasing retrieval defect at all — the one clerk case that caught it did so by accident. Building's corpus is small and homogeneous so expansion was already inert here — these cases exist as regression protection for when licensed code text is added.
